rec.name: PDP Quantity Buttons & Tiered Pricing

what.text: A PDP section that shows pack sizes or quantities as clickable buttons or cards (e.g. '1x', '2 x 300g', '6 x 400g'). Exactly one option is active at a time. Each option can carry a discount badge (e.g. '10%') and a 'Bestseller' pill, both with custom colors. Three layouts are available: Text only, Text + Badge, and Visual (product image, quantity info, discount badge). The active option is highlighted with a border, background or shadow. In the reference screenshots, badges sit on the top edge or top-right corner of a button, and the Bestseller pill sits above its button.

why.text: Showing bundle sizes up front turns quantity into a visible choice instead of a hidden field. Discount badges (5% / 10% / 15% / 20%) create a tiered-pricing anchor that rewards buying more, which raises units per order and AOV. The 'Bestseller' pill is social proof and a default nudge toward the preferred pack. A single highlighted selection reduces decision effort. In the Visual layout, stacked product images show the larger pack, which makes the extra value tangible.

how.text: Build it as a Shopify section with a repeatable block per option. Each block holds display text, Shopify quantity, optional discount badge text and color, optional Bestseller label and color, and an optional image (Visual layout only). A layout dropdown switches between Text only, Text + Badge and Visual. Badge positions are fixed per layout. Mobile stacks the options vertically or uses a horizontal scroll, depending on layout. There are two implementation routes. (1) Full custom selector: the chosen quantity is passed to the cart, which needs new discount logic so tier discounts apply and the correct number of items is added. The dev estimate is about 8–10 h plus 2–3 h per theme. (2) Style the theme's existing variant selector, where each variant is named like a quantity: about 2–3 h per theme, but it only changes the variant, not the cart quantity. The dev suggested starting with this for the Focal theme.

items: Layout type dropdown: Text only / Text + Badge / Visual
Per option: Shopify quantity (number passed to the cart)
Per option: product image (Visual layout only)
Mobile behavior: stacked or scroll, depending on layout

dependencies.text: Tiered discounts need a new discount logic (e.g. quantity-based automatic discounts or a Shopify Function) so the cart gets the right quantity at the right price. For combination or bundle products, the selection may need to target a defined parent product block. The sections are shared across themes (Sectionfy), so the cart and variant integration needs per-theme adjustment (est. 2–3 h each). The variant-styling route needs variants named after quantities and an existing theme variant selector. The reference themes appear to use variants and not a true quantity field.

images.caption: Text + Badge layout: text-only buttons with a pill-shaped 'Bestseller' label above one button; the selected option is filled black.
Visual layout: option cards with product image (stacked for larger packs), quantity text below, round discount badges (10% / 15% / 20%) at top right, and a highlighted active card.
Text + Badge layout (minimal): rectangular quantity buttons with a discount badge (5% / 10%) on the top edge; the active option has a thick dark border.
